title: Power Systems Engineer
summary: Design, model and commission grid-forming battery stations. Own protection, controls integration and grid studies from concept to energization.
responsibilities: Model station behaviour on weak and islanded networks
Lead commissioning and acceptance testing on site
Work with our software team on control strategies
requirements: Degree in electrical engineering or equivalent experience
Hands-on experience with power electronics, protection or distribution networks
Comfortable on site and at the simulation desk

title: Project Development Lead
summary: Find, shape and secure the sites and partnerships behind every new station, from first conversation to notice to proceed.
responsibilities: Originate and qualify new station opportunities
Lead land, permitting and partner workstreams
Build the commercial case for each project
Represent Nile Peak with communities and stakeholders
requirements: Experience developing energy or infrastructure projects in East Africa
Strong network across utilities, regulators or developers

title: Field Operations Lead
summary: Keep every station running. Build the field team, the maintenance playbook and the response routines that make our uptime boring.
responsibilities: Build and lead the field technician team
Run incident response with our remote operations desk
Feed field learnings back into station design
requirements: Experience operating electrical or industrial assets
Calm under pressure, at any hour
